  <div class="page-width page-width--narrow"><div class="theme-block" ><h2>Wing Foiling Camps</h2></div><div class="theme-block" ><div class="rte"><p>Would you like to learn in a group setting? This season we are adding some Wing Camps. 3 days full of good tips and water time guided by our experienced instructors. A really great way to meet other people, get good at winging and have a good time.</p>
</div></div><div class="theme-block" ><div class="rte"><p>Includes 3 days of shared amazing instruction, All of the equipment. Tow behind the jet skis on calm mornings. Welcome drink at Joe’s garage at the end of the first day.</p>
</div></div></div>
</div>
